{{Quote|The Senate is doing nothing-proposing few billz, voting on fewer. The Senate will do nothing about Ushmin.|[[Saba Sebatyne]]|<ref name="FJ" />}}
'''Ushmin''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="FJ" /> located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Ushmin was situated within [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] space, near the border with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. At this time, the economy of Ushmin was faltering, but the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] did nothing to help the planet. Nevertheless, the [[office of the Chief of State]], consisting of [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen|Treen]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton|Jaxton]], worked together to find a solution to the problem. Jaxton said that he was evaluating sites for new bases and could put Ushmin at the top of the list for the next base in that sector. In turn, Treen said that she could bring Disbursements into the plan.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ushmin was introduced in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'',<ref name="FJ" /> which was written by [[Christie Golden]] and released in [[2011]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Ushmin system/Legends|Ushmin star system]] and the planet itself in grid square K-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
